com.sun.tools.internal.xjc.api.util

类 ApClassLoader

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.ClassLoader
      • java.security.SecureClassLoader
        • java.net.URLClassLoader
          • com.sun.tools.internal.xjc.api.util.ApClassLoader
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable

    public final class ApClassLoader
extends URLClassLoader
    ClassLoader that loads Annotation Processing and specified classes both into the same classloader, so that they can reference each other.
    从以下版本开始:
    2.0 beta
    作者:
    Bhakti Mehta

    • 方法详细资料

      • loadClass

        public Class loadClass(String className)
                throws ClassNotFoundException
        从类复制的说明: ClassLoader
        Loads the class with the specified binary name. This method searches for classes in the same manner as the ClassLoader.loadClass(String, boolean) method. It is invoked by the Java virtual machine to resolve class references. Invoking this method is equivalent to invoking loadClass(name, false).
        覆盖:
        loadClass 在类中 ClassLoader
        参数:
        className - The binary name of the class
        返回:
        The resulting Class object
        抛出:
        ClassNotFoundException - If the class was not found

      • findClass

        protected Class findClass(String name)
                   throws ClassNotFoundException
        从类复制的说明: URLClassLoader
        Finds and loads the class with the specified name from the URL search path. Any URLs referring to JAR files are loaded and opened as needed until the class is found.
        覆盖:
        findClass 在类中 URLClassLoader
        参数:
        name - the name of the class
        返回:
        the resulting class
        抛出:
        ClassNotFoundException - if the class could not be found, or if the loader is closed.
